services.desc: WNY Skydiving is committed to offering transparency in pricing. We do not add junk fees-no sneaky gear rental upcharges, fuel surcharges, or weight-based fees. Our focus is ensuring our guests have the best experience possible from start to finish. Scheduling your group at WNY Skydiving is very simple! Once the first member of a group makes their booking, a Group Number ID will be auto-generated. Share that Group ID with members of your group and they can add themselves to the group until 48 hours prior to the reservation.
